description:
The Gelisim University, which was established by the Gelisim Education Culture Health and Social Service Foundation in 2008, named “Istanbul Gelisim Vocational School”, has increased its education quality over the years and has become one of the few universities in Turkey.

Adopting the principle of "Development" in every field needed by Turkey and the world, IGU has so far graduated 35,809 graduates who have been trained as leaders in accordance with the principles and principles of its accreditations. Collaborating with over 100 world universities, Istanbul Gelisim University also motivates associate, undergraduate, graduate and doctoral students to become international.

Istanbul Gelisim University offers its students a huge research complex consisting of over 100 laboratories in the campus area of ​​Istanbul, one of the financial and commercial centers of Turkey and the world. There are also 63 student clubs that allow them to engage in sports activities.

Located in the Avcılar district of Istanbul, Gelisim University offers its students many opportunities on campus. Istanbul Gelisim University provides dormitory facilities to its students. Students can meet their needs with the dormitories they have contracted with regarding dormitory facilities. At the same time, the university organizes many activities and 63 student clubs develop students in extracurricular activities.

Promising a very social living space, Istanbul Gelisim University has assumed a supportive role in the education life of students with its library and cafeteria on campus.
